A request asking for a busy id_slot still ran the prompt cache update

items.summary: The ggml/llama.cpp project updated its server to leave a busy slot untouched when a request pins it, addressing an issue where prompt cache updates were still performed on pinned slots. items.summary_detailed: The ggml/llama.cpp project updated its server to leave a busy slot untouched when a request pins it, addressing an issue where prompt cache updates were still performed on that slot. This change ensures that if a better match is found in the RAM cache while another request is generating, it can be loaded into the slot without interference. The update aims to optimize memory usage and improve performance by reducing unnecessary computations.

items.title: Sakana AI’s LLM Peer Review System Catches 73% of Core-Claim Errors
items.description:
Sakana AI’s TMLR paper introduces Multi-Layered Review, a 3-agent Claude-based reviewer, and a 1,164-error Contradiction Benchmark. MLR caught 73.43% of core-claim errors, versus 14.81% for the best prior system.

The post
items.summary: Sakana AI's Multi-Layered Review system, using a three-agent approach based on Claude, identified 73.43% of core-claim errors in research papers, significantly outperforming previous methods which caught only 14.81%. This advancement matters because it enhances the accuracy and reliability of peer review processes for artificial intelligence models.
items.summary_detailed: Sakana AI's TMLR paper presents a Multi-Layered Review system using three Claude-based reviewers, which identified 73.43% of core-claim errors in a benchmark test involving 1,164 errors. This significantly outperforms the previous best system, which caught only 14.81%. The broader impact could enhance the reliability and accuracy of AI-generated content through more rigorous peer review processes.

items.summary_detailed: Microsoft has released Microsoft-Decision-1, a decision model designed for routing, classification, verification, and agent control, which provides calibrated probabilities for answer options rather than generating text.
